cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Bring that empty box to my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

mechanism: A treats obedience as a professionally assessed task, correcting B question into a failed execution and using completion to impose a return trip.
confusable: D53 delegates useful unwanted work; D59 makes inconvenience itself test acceptance of A authority.
comparison: Window alternative expands discomfort into carrying a coat; box alternative repeats an unnecessary transfer to remove questioning.
seedUse: Empty box, desk, why question and return trip derive from D59-a; S03 converts them into precise sequence correction.
